items.text: Tomas is planning a 12-day trek in Nepal in April with 3 friends (4 people total). Each person has a budget of 2,400 USD. The highest point of the route is 5,364 metres.

Typical trekking permit costs in Nepal in 2026 are about 35-40 USD per person for classic treks (Annapurna, Everest, Langtang), with TIMS around 15 USD and national park or conservation permits around 22 USD each. Restricted areas cost far more, e.g. Upper Mustang at 50 USD per day.
Since 31 March 2023, foreign trekkers in Nepal must trek with a licensed guide through a registered agency.

Everest Base Camp trek permits for foreign trekkers: Sagarmatha National Park permit NPR 3,000 plus Khumbu Pasang Lhamu Rural Municipality permit NPR 3,000, about NPR 6,000 (roughly US$45) per person in total; TIMS card is not required in the Khumbu. Some other sources list a TIMS card too, so confirm with the agency.

A licensed guide on the Everest Base Camp trek costs about USD 25 to 35 per day including food and accommodation; porters cost about USD 15 to 25 per day. Another source gives a guide at USD 25 to 45 per day plus food and lodging.

Everest Base Camp (South, Nepal) is at 5,364 metres (17,598 ft), so the 5,364 m highest point the user gave matches the Everest Base Camp trek. Kala Patthar (about 5,545 m) is often higher on the route.

Booking order for a 12-day Everest Base Camp trek in April for 4 people (2,400 USD each, 9,600 total), built on the Researcher's facts. Route to be confirmed as Everest Base Camp (5,364 m matches). 1) Contact a registered trekking agency first: licensed guide and permits are mandatory, April is peak season, and a pair shares one guide and one porter (2 guides, 2 porters). Get a firm written quote. 2) Lukla flights (domestic, Kathmandu-Lukla return), booked through the agency, since they fill up in April. 3) International flights to Kathmandu, timed to the agency's start date. 4) Travel insurance covering trekking to about 5,500 m and helicopter evacuation, bought before departure. 5) Gear rental or purchase in Kathmandu. 6) Tips at the end of the trek. Estimated split (USD, ground costs): Permits (NPR 6,000 per person, about 45 each) 180. Guides 2 x 360 (about 30/day x 12 days) 720. Porters 2 x 240 (about 20/day x 12) 480. Lukla return flights 4 x 400 (range 160 to 450 each) 1,600. Insurance 4 x 200 800. Teahouse meals and beds on trail 4 x 360 1,440. Kathmandu hotel and meals 480. Gear rental 600. Tips 500. Nepal visa on arrival about 4 x 30 = 120. Misc (SIM, water treatment, snacks) 300. Subtotal about 7,220 (about 1,805 per person). Buffer about 2,380 (about 595 per person). Not included: international flights to Kathmandu, which must fit within the remaining buffer or be paid separately. Confirm the total with the agency before paying.

items.text: Ines charges 95 euros per hour as a freelance data consultant.
Ines has 14 billable hours free each week.
Ines's biggest client, Orlin, pays about 40 days late.

Monthly income estimate for Ines: 95 EUR/hour x 14 billable hours/week = 1,330 EUR/week, about 5,763 EUR/month (using 52/12 = 4.33 weeks). Treat this as a ceiling that assumes all 14 hours are billed every week; a prudent planning figure is about 80% of that (about 4,600 EUR/month) until real billing is confirmed. Cash-flow note: Orlin pays about 40 days late, so monthly income from his work arrives roughly 5-6 weeks after it is earned. This is a timing gap, not lost income. Once the gap is in place, monthly receipts match billing, but Ines must cover about 40 days of Orlin billing from savings. If all 14 hours are for Orlin, that is about 1,330 x 40/7 = roughly 7,600 EUR of working capital tied up. Actual Orlin share and invoicing schedule are unknown and should be confirmed.

Draft payment reminder email from Ines to her client Orlin (friendly, firm, professional; no income figures):

Subject: Payment reminder: Invoice [INVOICE NUMBER]

Hi Orlin,

I hope you're well. I'm writing to remind you that invoice [INVOICE NUMBER], for [AMOUNT], was due on [DUE DATE] and has not yet been paid.

I know invoices can slip through the cracks, so I wanted to flag it promptly. Could you please confirm when payment will be made? If it has already been sent, thank you, and please send me the payment reference so I can match it on my side.

Payments on my invoices are due within the agreed terms, and I'd appreciate it if future invoices could be settled on time. If there's an issue with the invoice or anything you need from me, let me know and I'll sort it out quickly.

Thanks very much,
Ines

items.text: Pedro is moving to a two-bedroom flat in Lisbon, which has no washing machine.
The rental van Pedro can hire for the move holds 15 cubic metres.
The movers Pedro has quoted charge 85 euros an hour.
A Lavamais self-service laundromat is located just north of Anjos metro station on the green line in Lisbon, with washing machines in 8, 13 and 16 kg sizes and four dryers.
Lisbon has rental listings that include an in-unit washer/dryer, and some drop-off laundry services charge by weight (one reviewer reported 3.5 euros per kg for wash and dry without ironing).

Move plan for Pedro's move to a two-bedroom flat in Lisbon (flat has no washing machine):
1. Washing machine: first ask the landlord whether a washer is left in the flat or included in the rent. If not, buy a basic new or second-hand machine locally (or rent one for the first months) and arrange delivery and installation for move-in day. Until it is set up, use a self-service laundromat such as Lavamais near Anjos metro (green line), after confirming it is still open and checking current prices, since the sources are older.
2. Van: the 15 m³ van is reasonable for a two-bedroom flat, but only if the belongings are mostly furniture and standard boxes. Make an inventory and measure the big items before booking; if it looks tight, consider a second trip or a larger van.
3. Movers at 85 euros/hour: book only for the heavy lifting or the van driving, and keep the job short by loading in advance. Estimate cost as hours x 85 euros (for example, 4 hours is about 340 euros) and get a fixed quote before booking.
4. Timeline: confirm the move-in date and key handover with the landlord, book van and movers together, and arrange utilities and internet for the new flat.
Prices and availability for laundry options are indicative only and need checking before use.
